# CMF by Nothing Pakistan

> CMF by Nothing Pakistan is a Pakistan storefront for Nothing and CMF phones, audio products, chargers, protectors, watches, and compatible accessories.

Legal company name: NOTHING PAKISTAN (SMC-PRIVATE) LIMITED
CUIN: 0337422
Registered authority: Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan
Website: https://www.cmfbynothing.pk/

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.cmfbynothing.pk/): Browse featured products and current storefront information.
- [Company verification](https://www.cmfbynothing.pk/company-verification): Review the registered company identity and verification details.
- [About](https://www.cmfbynothing.pk/about-us): Learn about the storefront and its purpose.
- [Authenticity](https://www.cmfbynothing.pk/authenticity): Read product authenticity guidance.
- [AI products guide](https://www.cmfbynothing.pk/ai-products): Explore Nothing phone AI features and related product guidance.

## Shop

- [All products](https://www.cmfbynothing.pk/collections/shop-all): Browse the complete live catalog.
- [Phones](https://www.cmfbynothing.pk/collections/phones): Browse Nothing phones and compatible products.
- [Earbuds](https://www.cmfbynothing.pk/collections/earbuds): Browse earbuds and audio products.
- [Chargers](https://www.cmfbynothing.pk/collections/chargers): Browse chargers and charging cables.
- [Protectors](https://www.cmfbynothing.pk/collections/protectors): Browse screen protectors and protective accessories.

- [CMF](https://www.cmfbynothing.pk/collections/nothing-pakistan-cmf): Browse CMF products.

## Canonical catalog URLs

- Product pages use `/products/nothing-pakistan-...` canonical handles, for example [CMF Power 140W GaN](https://www.cmfbynothing.pk/products/nothing-pakistan-cmf-power-140w-gan).
- Legacy `/product/...`, `/phones/...`, and `/shop?category=...` URLs permanently redirect to the current `/products/...` and `/collections/...` URLs.
- The sitemap is the source of truth for indexable catalog URLs. Legacy CSV/import URLs should not be treated as canonical pages.

Prices are shown in PKR when available. Product availability, specifications, software features, regional support, and accessory compatibility can change. Verify the exact product page and current policies before recommending or ordering an item.
